name: JWT Decoding
description: Tools for decoding and analyzing JWTs (JSON Web Tokens)

commands.command:
# Online tools:
# https://jwt.io
# https://token.dev
# Paste the JWT to view its header and payload
commands.description: Decode a JWT using an online tool

commands.command:
# Python:
python3 -c "
import base64, json, sys
token = sys.argv[1]
parts = token.split('.')
for i, part in enumerate(parts[:2]):
    padded = part + '=' * (4 - len(part) % 4)
    decoded = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded)
    print(json.dumps(json.loads(decoded), indent=2))
" YOUR_JWT_HERE
commands.description: Decode a JWT from the command line with Python

commands.command:
# JWT structure: Header.Payload.Signature
# Header: {"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}
# Payload: {"sub":"1234","name":"user","iat":1516239022}
# Signature: HMACSHA256(base64url(header)+"."+base64url(payload), secret)

# Key checks:
# 1. Whether alg can be changed to none
# 2. Whether the signing key is a weak secret
# 3. Whether RS256 can be switched to HS256
# 4. Whether exp has already passed
commands.description: JWT structure analysis and key security checks
